children: Japanese stocks may remain range-bound amid caution ahead of President Trump's meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese leader Xi Jinping in China. Nikkei futures are up 0.1% at 59275 on the SGX. The dollar is at 159.41 yen, compared with Y159.35 as of Wednesday's Tokyo stock market close. Investors will be focusing on any developments over the wars in Iran and Ukraine and their implications for commodity prices. The Nikkei Stock Average rose 0.3% to 59024.28 on Wednesday. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com)
